|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-bowtothefirstorder_ai-2026-01-20.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-D-bowtothefirstorder_ai-2026-01-20-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-D-bowtothefirstorder_ai-2023-01-22.png]], 22 January 2023) → [[File:V4-D-bowtothefirstorder_ai-2026-01-20-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-D-bowtothefirstorder_ai-2026-01-20.png]], 20 January 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Bow To The First Order (ALT)]]): '''First published 20 January 2023''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/bowtothefirstorder_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/46c4164e553243da41d2619bc5de512927e7aea0 commit 46c4164]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 21 January 2023<ref name="img-Darkd8b70ba">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d8b70bab5e6d97f961c2744b77242248f4d06b96 commit d8b70ba] (21 January 2023); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Debris Zone”. Text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ ''Finalizer''. Once per character, when you deploy Hux, Kylo, Phasma, or Snoke to an [Episode VII] battleground, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]” This image was first published on 20 January 2023 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/bowtothefirstorder_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/46c4164e553243da41d2619bc5de512927e7aea0 commit 46c4164]); the card-size GIF uploaded 22 January 2023 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8b233aa85d63a71da7199f011eec3b5b0b153b17 commit 8b233aa], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E1) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 20 January 2026<ref name="img-Dark6cae8c9">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d commit 6cae8c9] (20 January 2026); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “(AI)” → “(ALT)” at bottom right (the PC renamed Alternate Image cards from “AI” to “ALT”; an image relabelled “(AI)” → “(ALT)” is an errata of the AI image, Bill 12 Nov 2026); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Debris Zone”. It is the current image. Text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ ''Finalizer''. Once per character, when you deploy Hux, Kylo, Phasma, or Snoke to an [Episode VII] battleground, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
